public.text: Consent services are said to reference the Client Registry. This is appropriate for identity resolution, but consent may also involve representatives, guardians, organisations, and anonymous or pseudonymous subjects.
public.suggestedRevision: Define how consent records identify data subjects, representatives, authority, relationship, assurance, and applicable identity context without forcing all use cases into one person identifier.
